summary: CFC filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, disclosing that on September 8, 2026 it notified investors it will redeem all $400 million of its 5.60% Medium-Term Notes due 2026 (CUSIP 63743HFK3) on October 13, 2026 at par plus accrued interest. The redemption, funded with cash on hand, is intended to reduce interest expense rather than return capital; a debt extinguishment, the US-equivalent of an issuer call/redemption notice. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for any concurrent refinancing or further liability-management actions.
